title: Owner: look at the three apps side by side
goal: The owner confirms NERV, Grover and FPVBuddy share the tokens and components
acceptance: Open the three apps: status rows, cards and approval cards look and behave the same; colours and type match NERV's style guide
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: a visual walk through three apps. Not a measurement.
